# Plot one core in 3-D with its outline

Draws the scars of one core as arrows from start to end. If an outline
is given, also draws the outline, the fitted plane of intersection and
its centre, and colours each scar by its Centripetality Index (CPI):
blue for scars running towards the centre (180 degrees), grey along the
edge (90), red away from the centre (0). Use it to check that scars and
outline share a coordinate frame (the starts should lie on the outline)
before reading CPI and PRA.

## Usage

``` r
plot_core(
  data,
  id = NULL,
  outline = NULL,
  id_col = "ID",
  start_cols = c("Start_X", "Start_Y", "Start_Z"),
  end_cols = c("End_X", "End_Y", "End_Z"),
  min_length = 0
)
```

## Arguments

- data:

  A scar table. If it holds several cores, `id` selects one.

- id:

  The ID of the core to draw. May be omitted when `data` holds a single
  core.

- outline:

  Optional outline of the core (see
  [`fit_intersection_plane()`](https://peiyuanxiao.github.io/spharmlithic/reference/fit_intersection_plane.md))
  or a plane fitted with
  [`fit_intersection_plane()`](https://peiyuanxiao.github.io/spharmlithic/reference/fit_intersection_plane.md).

- id_col:

  Name of the core ID column. Default `"ID"`.

- start_cols, end_cols:

  Names of the start- and end-point coordinate columns (X, Y, Z).
  Defaults `Start_X/Y/Z` and `End_X/Y/Z`, the columns the scars are
  recorded in. The aligned columns of
  [`align_scar_batch()`](https://peiyuanxiao.github.io/spharmlithic/reference/align_scar_batch.md)
  (`s_x`... and `e_x`...) give the same results: these indices do not
  change when a core is rotated or moved.

- min_length:

  Scars shorter than this (in the units of the coordinates) are left
  out. Default 0 (keep all). Use it to repeat an analysis without small
  scars, for example `min_length = 10` for 10 mm.

## Value

A `plotly` figure.

## See also

[`export_outline_html()`](https://peiyuanxiao.github.io/spharmlithic/reference/export_outline_html.md),
[`cpi_pra_batch()`](https://peiyuanxiao.github.io/spharmlithic/reference/cpi_pra_batch.md),
[`export_alignment_html_svd()`](https://peiyuanxiao.github.io/spharmlithic/reference/export_alignment_html_svd.md)

## Examples

``` r
t <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 13)[-13]
start <- cbind(30 * cos(t), 30 * sin(t), 0)
end <- start * 0.4
end[, 3] <- -5
one <- data.frame(ID = "disc", Start_X = start[, 1], Start_Y = start[, 2],
                  Start_Z = start[, 3], End_X = end[, 1], End_Y = end[, 2],
                  End_Z = end[, 3])
u <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 200)
plot_core(one, outline = cbind(30 * cos(u), 30 * sin(u), 0))
```
